# Class: `CellStateManager`

Keeps cell IDs, saved records, keyframes, and result-table labels consistent.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-cell.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_cell.py#L50) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

Allocation uses the lowest available non-negative ID after considering current geometry, keyframes, and records. Renaming rejects collisions and updates dependent headers and freeze labels.
